csv_scope_of_work: The State of Oregon, acting by and through the Oregon Department of Energy ( Agency )is issuing this Request for Qualifications ( RFQ ) to establish a short-list of prequalified Energy Analyst Firms to conduct energy consumption analysis for state agencies ( Contracting Agency ) that construct new facilities or renovate existing facilities An Energy Analyst is an advocate for energy efficient design resulting in a building that serves as a model of energy efficiency and leads design team efforts in implementing energy efficient strategies in the building systems design. Through early involvement in the design process, the Energy Analyst assures energy efficiency is an integral part of the building design.

relevance_explanation:

- Scope is focused on energy analysis and building systems efficiency, not structural or bridge design.
- Disciplines requested are electrical engineering and energy engineering, outside sbp's core structural scope.
- No defined building project, span, long-span roof, special structure, or architectural competition component is identified.
- Matches sbp exclusion tendencies for MEP/building services and framework agreements without technical structural specification.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. No explicit minimum number of references or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
award_criteria: Not stated in the provided text.
